title: CloudTalk × Madrid SDR team — real recorded qualification call
description: A real recorded discovery + BANT call published by CloudTalk on YouTube: Nick (account specialist, CloudTalk) qualifies Bradford (SDR manager at a Madrid startup dialing from mobile phones, logging into HubSpot by hand). Pain, geography, seat count, decision process, CRM, budget and a booked follow-up with an account executive all surface within 9 minutes. Transcribed locally with faster-whisper (small.en), speakers labeled by hand; timestamps align to the YouTube video so the copilot can run in sync with playback.
expected: qualifies and books a next step

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey Bradford, how you doing?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Great, man. Great, Nick. It's great to connect.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, happy to be here as well. Whereabouts are you calling in from?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: I'm based in Madrid at the moment. Based in Madrid in Spain. What about yourself?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I am in Barcelona, Spain. So yeah, I'm just enjoying my day here. Look Brad, just to give you a brief introduction of who I am before I continue with the call. I am Nick, I am your account specialist for this region, and we have about 15 minutes for the call. Is that fine with you?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, that works perfectly. I've got a hard stop after the 15 minutes anyway. So yeah, we can wrap it up within the time.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, let's at least have a go and see what happens from it. Just so you know what the call is going to look like: I do want to know more about what you're using as a solution, just see what a fit can be as well as what you guys are looking for in a solution. If the fit's there, we'll outline some next few steps and just take it from there. Sound good?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Perfect, man. Sounds great. Let's dive into it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, do you mind then, perhaps give me a brief introduction of yourself as well as what you guys are currently using as a solution at the moment.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, for sure. So I'm the SDR manager for a small startup here in Madrid. We're looking to renew some of our solutions going into the new year. One being our calling solution. We're currently using a local landline provider, we're using mobile phones, and we're looking to really just increase the number of dials at this point.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: We're employing a couple more SDRs going into the new year. So yeah, management's pretty much looking to just introduce a couple more solutions to improve a couple things. But that's essentially it, man. We're using mobile phones and we're just looking for something a little bit more advanced at this point.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. And with those mobile phones, and you said you want to increase dials, is there a particular reason to make that switch? Is it, do you find it slow, or what's that reason for the switch now?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, so I think now our team doesn't really enjoy using mobile phones because it's a very manual process. Like we're trying to reach between 50 to 100 dials a day. And then we're also using our CRM at the moment, so now they have to manually log the calls, add the notes. I can't track any of their analytics.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: So sometimes they say they're doing 50 calls and then there's no way for me to really see if they're actually making those 50 calls. So yeah, we just need more of a sense of control and reporting on what our agents are doing, and making sure they're actually doing their work.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And is there a reason as to why you want those? You know, of course, to see if they're doing their work, but are you guys measured on that? Does anything come down regarding that?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah. So at the moment, if you think about it from a management perspective: if our team has a target of 50 calls a day, for example, and they hit 50 calls per day, we should be able to reach our business target. Right now we're not reaching our business target, and we don't know if they're making 50 calls per day.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Essentially, based on how we view things here, if they manage 50 calls per day, that should result in X amount of conversations, which should result in X amount of deals being made. Right now there's no tracking of that. So we're pretty much walking blind at the moment. And it's not going to be good going into 2026 with our current setup.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got you. Okay. So this is something we definitely can help out with, which I'll touch upon towards the end. Although before we get to that, these calls, where exactly are you guys making these calls to? Which countries are you targeting?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: So we're focusing mainly on Spain and the UK for now, with the potential to expand if everything goes well next year. But right now, just those two regions.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: UK and Spain. I take it then you'd want a number from both countries, from the UK and from Spain?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah. We'd like all agents to have a number from each. So an individual agent must have two numbers, one from the UK, one from Spain.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got you. Okay. And how many agents are we talking about then? How many would that be?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: So we're going to start with six and then potentially expand into, I think it was 12 by the end of Jan, if things go well. So yeah, we initially want to start within Jan for six licenses.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, super. Yeah, no worries. And then to make that happen, are you the person in charge of, I suppose, signing off on it? Or do you have to speak with anyone else, perhaps the finance team? What does that process look like for you guys?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah. So initially, I'm not the person that would make the decision. I'm just kind of previewing the products at the moment, seeing what's out there. But I would get approval from our finance team and CEO as well, just to clarify all that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got you. Okay, sure, sounds right. And these calls though, when you guys are making these calls, where do you organize the information afterwards? I know you mentioned using a CRM, but I don't believe I caught the name. Where do you guys put the information then?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah. So we're using HubSpot now. How it's working is our agents would make a call off their mobile phone. We have all the leads within our CRM, within HubSpot. And then they would manually input the number in their mobile, make the call, take some notes within HubSpot, log the activity in a sense.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: They log the activity. We don't really know if they've made the call or not because we can't listen to the call either. But yeah, it's a very manual process. And it's a little bit frustrating trying to manage the team of six agents and trying to make sure, hey, have you made the notes? Have you logged the call? How many calls are you on? So that's essentially our setup now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And apart from the call tagging, the notes and the ability to track, is there any other feature that you're kind of going for? Like, okay, actually, if we could have this, this would be great. Or is that kind of the main area that you guys are going towards?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: I think a little bit more automation in a sense. So for example, I don't know if it's a feature that you guys have, but if our agent makes the call, sometimes our agents don't leave notes, so I can't see the context of a conversation. It would be cool if we could just have a summary of the conversation automatically input into HubSpot within the contact, just to remove the concern of making sure our agents are taking notes, etc. It would also allow them to focus on other stuff.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, no worries. We can help with that. But before we kind of move on a bit more, do you mind if I summarize your thing back to you? We've had a bit of a conversation, I just want to wrap this side up.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, of course.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: So what I understood right now: you guys are using a local provider and you're using your traditional landline and mobile phones. And you're facing issues in the sense that it's just too slow. You also can't really log anything in your CRM. You also want to have more visibility into what your agents are doing, so a sense of tracking or reporting capabilities.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: From what I understood, you are going to be going with six agents at the end of January, first of January or end of December. You do put all the information in HubSpot as your CRM. From a decision-making perspective, what I got here is that you're the one who pretty much takes charge, although you do have to speak with your team and then get approval from the finance team. Is that everything that we kind of touched upon?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, just now that you've summarized that, I forgot to actually mention, we do want to increase the number of dials. So I did see on your website you have something like a power dialer or a parallel dialer. So I'd like to just include that within there, just so we know that I've included all the features. And then do you guys offer WhatsApp at all?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yes. So to address your points, we do offer WhatsApp for these regions, so that won't be an issue if you're looking to have that. At the same time, if you guys are going for an increase of dials, we do have the power dialer. It lets you call one after the other: you dial out a call, it rings out, and after a certain time it brings up the next person. That way your agents are constantly dialing.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You also mentioned before that you want some visibility and tracking. Whenever your agent is making a call, you get to see absolutely everything. Every call they make, where they made the call, what happened to the call. That way you can then have a better sense of reporting for them, and you just know how to improve their calls. That way you can reach those goals that you guys have, and of course boost those dials out to the number you wanted.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Now, this does come down to a price range of anywhere between 29 to 39 euros per person per month. Is that something that fits within budget, would you say?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, I think that's something that would work. I mean, we're paying a lot less than that at the moment, to be honest with you. We do have budget for a new solution. And from what I've seen on the website, I did review the pricing, it seems pretty within reach with what we're willing to spend on a new solution. So the budget is not an issue for us at the moment.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got you. Okay, well, happy to hear. Look, the next step for this is I'd like to book you in with an account executive. He's just going to go over a bit more in depth about what you guys are doing, perhaps understand your situation a bit better, and at the end touch upon pricing. In order to do this, we do have a time open later today. What did you say you're based out of again? Where are you calling in from?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: So yeah, same time zone as you.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Same time zone. So at 4 p.m. later today, would a half an hour meeting with the account executive work?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, that would work perfectly. I'll maybe invite someone from our team to the call as well, just in case there's any other questions.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure. Yeah, let's do that. You can either send me their email or you can just invite them as you approach the time. Cool. Sound good?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, that's perfect.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Well then, thanks for your time, Brad. Enjoy the rest of your time in Madrid, and I'll send an email to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Awesome, man. Nick, appreciate your time. Merry Christmas, happy new year, and I look forward to the meeting later today.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Awesome, sounds good. Have a good one, man. Bye-bye.
